lines.text: Many learners say: Did you went there yesterday?
Better: Did you go there yesterday?

native.tip: 中文的动词不变形，容易把“过去”说两遍。did 已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Did you went there yesterday?”😅 did 已经表示过去，后面的动词要用原形 go，不能再说 went：“Did you go there yesterday?”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Did you go there yesterday?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Did already shows the past, so the next verb stays short.
en.caption: Do you say “Did you went there yesterday?” 😅 Did already shows the past, so the next verb stays short: “Did you go there yesterday?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
